answer: Plant a grove of trust: every account grows a small grove of real local peers who vouch for it with time-locked deposits, and a grove sheltering a fake member forfeits its whole deposit, so vouching for strangers is ruinous. Then stand on the ledge of a public knoll: each epoch a random sample of accounts must perform a short live task before independent observers, and anyone who cannot appear in time slips off the ledge. Clones share one operator's hands and schedule, so they fail the live test together. A fresh grove needs weeks of shared activity before its vouches count.
